name: Personal Runewell

heightening.text: The amount of damage dealt by the runewell's bolts increases by 1d6.

entries: The runelords of Thassilon pioneered the creation of runewells, magical artifacts that could extract and store the power of sin magic from mortal souls. A circle of light carves its way across the ground as you create your very own runewell, your personal rune flaring to life within it as you add your own sin to those seven revered in the past. Whenever any creature Casts a Spell within your personal runewell, the well resonates, with your choice of effects.
If you cast personal runewell a second time, your previous personal runewell vanishes. You can Dismiss the spell.
